title: Sawada-2022-mapping-10.1038/s41467-022-32644-y
description: Intracranial EEG evoked-potential epochs recorded during single-pulse electrical stimulation of the amygdala (electrical stimulation tract-tracing, es-TT) in 11 neurosurgical patients across 46 stimulation runs. The data support mapping the effective connectivity of human amygdala subdivisions. Epochs are time-locked to the stimulus artefact and were converted to BIDS from a MATLAB-formatted OSF release.
methods_description: Epoched iEEG (sampling rate 8 kHz per the original article) recorded with depth, strip and grid electrodes during single-pulse electrical stimulation of the amygdala; typically 60 epochs of 2 s per run, with the stimulus artefact as time zero.
